svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)
ACE profile requires the custom cache-probe proxy described in DEP-002; the diagram does not claim it has been implemented.
Internal multi-hart coherence plus an ACE snoop proxy for external coherent agents.
IRQ, DBG, AXIL, MMIO, ACERQ, ACESN,
Executes application software on identical 64-bit harts with private caches and per-hart interrupt/debug state.
Maintains cache-line ownership and aggregates cluster performance event taps.
TREQ, TRES, LREQ, LRES, DREQ, DRES,
Stores shared last-level cache lines and performs its configured BIST and flush operations.
Adapts supported external ACE requests and snoops to local cache probes without losing dirty data.
Routes non-cacheable peripheral transactions to the external AXI4 device fabric.
Routes software access to cluster performance controls and LLC service functions.
Counts selected hardware events, captures counter snapshots, and reports overflow causes.
Routes external debug requests and returns each active hart's debug state.
ACE AR/AW/W/R/B channels with transaction attributes and RACK/WACK
Event selector, counter enable, snapshot and cause control
Non-cacheable device read/write requests, routed from the coherence-fabric device path to the MMIO manager.
Device read data and AXI response, returned to the coherence-fabric requester.
The coherence observability tap aggregates event vectors from the CPU tiles, coherence fabric and LLC and presents them to the PMU.
